description: Sen. Rogers explains her vote for SB 1015 and why states have the right and duty to protect children. She cites Supreme Court precedent and European bans on child “gender transitioning,” warning against irreversible harm to minors. Watch now: SB 1015 restricts gender transition procedures for minors and provides safeguards for those who later detransition.
